description: Which list track becomes the radar's ACC target: the target lies in a corridor around the radar's own path (0x33E byte 5), not simply the nearest car. Events are new ACC acquisitions with a linked list track and a valid radar path. Derived; radar-witness authority (the radar's own choice, not a physical reference). Sets as in summary_tracker_selection.json.

containment_2_5_m.note: share of acquisitions whose target lies within 2.5 m of the path (3.0 m in brackets in the source)

corridor_rule_free_running.note: smallest |y_path| inside 2.5 m, kept while inside 3 m; share of cycles with a linked ACC list track on which it names the radar's track

in_path_level.note: the radar's IN_PATH level is not an instantaneous corridor test
